name: v2-retract
review: Extruder.cpp defaults to 3 mm retract, zero recovery surplus and zero Z lift; G10/G11 therefore command 300 steps in opposite directions at 100 steps/mm. The explicit moves and final X/E positions also agree with the commands. Independently integrating the source-defined, tick-rounded acceleration profile predicts each move's final pulse within one 10 microsecond tick of the reference; the planned trapezoid duration is longer than the captured last-pulse duration. This does not validate physical extrusion or pulse-level timing on a board.
